ADX Energy Ltd.: Austrian Operations Update
HOCH-1 Production Testing and Vienna Basin Production Enhancement Program
MB well services rig HOCH-1 Phase 2 testing; ADX Energy Ltd.
"Further HOCH-1 testing planned in conjunction with a well work program targeting a 100 BOEPD incremental production from ADX' Vienna Basin Fields"
The Hochfeld-1 (HOCH-1) shallow gas exploration well was drilled, cased and completed encountering up to eight (8) biogenic gas reservoirs within the Hall basin floor fan formation (
and the Base Hall Channel formation (
HOCH-1 well testing is being undertaken

in two (2) phases. Phase 1 is completed with the testing of four (4) reservoirs in the Hall Fm. as well as a zone in the Hall Channel. Phase 2 testing will focus on Hall Channel zones only (refer to figure 2 at the PDF file).

Hall Channel reservoirs intersected in the HOCH-1 well have been mapped and correlated to nearby gas discoveries, indicating the potential for a large lateral extension of the deeper sand bodies. This interpretation is further supported by reserves data from Hall Channel production wells.
Flow data and pressure data recovered from down hole pressure gauges confirm additional gas flow contribution from three additional gas zones during comingled testing.

The testing of at least one (1) additional Hall Channel reservoir (Test Zone #6) is planned during Phase 2. A work over rig will be required to remove the current completion, drill out a cement plug to access the deeper zones and re-run a testing completion prior to perforation of Test Zone #6.

A work over rig program combining production enhancement work at ADX' Vienna Basin Fields and the HOCH-1 testing program will commence on 19 October 2026. The program of well work activities is scheduled as follows;
Vienna Basin well gas zone perforation and gas completion installation in an existing well;
HOCH-1 cement plug drill out, recompletion and Hall Channel testing; and
Vienna Basin well perforation of new production interval and install sand retention completion.The HOCH-1 flow testing is planned to commence on 15 December 2026.
The Vienna Basin well work is expected to add approximately 100 BOEPD of oil and gas production.

ADX Executive Chairman, Mr Ian Tchacos, said

The combined production enhancement and well test work program allows ADX to utilise a contracted work over rig to efficiently and cost effectively incorporate HOCH-1 testing work with ADX production enhancement program at our 100% owned Vienna Basin fields.
"The positive HOCH-1 exploration results recorded from gas zones tested to date provides confidence regarding the testing of additional zones in the Hall Channel Sands.

"The incorporation of the Vienna Basin well work program provides the opportunity to further increase Vienna Basin production by approximately 100 BOEPD (representing an approximate 40% increase in ADX' Austrian production) at a time when Brent oil price is trading at approximately US$100 per barrel and European gas price (TTF November contract) is trading at approximately EUR 75 per MWh which equates to US$ 25 per MMBTU or an oil price equivalent of US$152 per barrel.
"We look forward to reporting on the results of the Vienna Basin well work program and the further gas reservoirs testing work at HOCH-1 over the coming month."
